items.name: Kuanzhai Alley
items.th: ควานไจ่เซี่ยงจึ
items.atSource: OSM way/588905842, WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: Three restored Qing-era lanes of courtyard houses, teahouses and snack stalls. Come at dusk when the lanterns come on; after 10 pm it is calmest.
tags: Walk from the hotel, about 750 m

items.name: People's Park & Heming Teahouse
items.zh: 人民公园 · 鹤鸣茶社
items.th: เหรินหมินกงหยวน · เฮ่อหมิงฉาเซ่อ
items.atSource: OSM node/2823785815 (鹤鸣茶社), WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: Sit with a gaiwan of tea by the lake at Chengdu's oldest park teahouse and watch locals play cards. A price board at the door set a ¥16 minimum per person, ¥18 after 6 pm (April 2026 review).
tags: Metro Line 2 People's Park, one stop from Tonghuimen

items.name: Du Fu Thatched Cottage
items.th: ตู้ฝู่เฉ่าถัง
items.atSource: OSM way/299409723, WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: A quiet bamboo-and-pond garden museum built around the Tang poet Du Fu's rebuilt cottage. Allow two hours; buy tickets on the museum's WeChat account.
tags: Walk from the hotel, about 1.7 km

items.name: Qingyang Palace
items.atSource: OSM relation/18440094, WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: Chengdu's main Taoist temple, closest sight to the hotel. Rub the bronze goats for luck and have ¥10 gaiwan tea under the old trees; an hour is enough.
tags: Walk from the hotel, about 400 m

items.name: Wuhou Shrine & Jinli
items.th: อู่โหวฉือ · จิ่นหลี่
items.atSource: OSM node/5402706721 (Wuhou Shrine ticket office), WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: Three Kingdoms shrine with the famous red-wall bamboo lane; arrive at 9:00 for empty photos and bring your passport. Exit into Jinli next door, a free old-style street that lights its lanterns around 6:30 pm in winter.
tags: Metro Line 3/5 Gaoshengqiao, exit D, ~10 min walk

items.name: Wenshu Monastery
items.th: เหวินซูย่วน
items.atSource: OSM way/660894418, WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: A working Buddhist monastery with incense halls, a gaiwan teahouse and a cheap vegetarian canteen. One to two hours; pair it with Taikoo Li the same day.
tags: Metro Line 1 Wenshu Monastery (文殊院站)

items.name: Chengdu Panda Base
items.zh: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
items.th: เฉิงตูต้าสงเมาฝานอวี้เหยียนจิวจีตี้
items.atSource: OSM way/941885688 (park area centroid, not the gate), WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02; ask the driver for 南门 (South Gate)
items.note: Real-name online booking is required for every visitor (passport number; bring the same passport). In November the morning slot opens at 08:00: be at the South Gate for opening, because pandas are most active 8–11 am at feeding time. Allow 3.5–5 hours.
tags: Metro Line 3 Panda Avenue (熊猫大道) exit A + bus D025

items.name: Taikoo Li & Daci Temple
items.zh: 成都远洋太古里 · 大慈寺
items.th: เฉิงตูหย่วนหยางไท่กู่หลี่ · ต้าฉือซื่อ
items.atSource: OSM way/288055435 (大慈寺, inside Taikoo Li), WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: Open-air luxury shopping lanes built in old Sichuan style around the Tang-founded Daci Temple. See the temple in the morning quiet, the lanes in the evening lights.
tags: Daci entry: free per Ctrip, ¥30 per one guide

items.name: Chunxi Road & the IFS climbing panda
items.zh: 春熙路 · 成都国际金融中心(IFS)
items.th: ชุนซีลู่ · กั๋วจี้จินหรงจงซิน
items.atSource: OSM node/14232210743 (成都国际金融中心 mall), WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: Chengdu's busiest shopping street. The giant panda sculpture "I Am Here" hangs off the IFS wall; go up to the 7th-floor rooftop garden to stand beside it, ideally around 10 am before the queues.
tags: Metro Line 2/3 Chunxi Road, exit A

items.name: Anshun Bridge & Jiuyan Bridge at night
items.th: อันซุ่นหลางเฉียว · จิ่วเหยี่ยนเฉียว
items.atSource: OSM node/6349200760 (安顺廊桥), WGS-84 converted to GCJ-02
items.note: The lit covered bridge reflected in the Jin River, with Jiuyan Bridge's bar strip just downstream. Arrive around 7 pm as the lights come up; the metro stops around 11:30 pm.
tags: Optional river boat from Dongmen Wharf ~¥80–118
Walk from Taikoo Li, about 1.4 km
